dmv.1037.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DMV  WHERE Record_Type IN ('TRL', 'BOAT') AND Registration_Class IN ('PAS', 'COM', 'LTR', 'BOT', 'MOT', 'TRL', 'SRF', 'PSD', 'OMT', 'OMS', 'ATV', 'SNO', 'HOU', 'ORG', 'SEM', 'HIS', 'IRP', 'OMR', 'STA', 'AGR', 'SPO', 'FAR', 'RGL', 'MED') AND State IN ('NY', 'NJ', 'OK', 'PA', 'MD', 'IL', 'TX', 'FL', 'GA', 'CT', 'IN', 'OH', 'WI', 'MA', 'AZ', 'CA', 'VA', 'NC', 'TN', 'NH', 'AL', 'VT', 'SC', 'MO', 'MN', 'CO', 'MI', 'DE', 'WA', 'NT', 'RI', 'AR') AND Body_Type = 'SUBN' AND Fuel_Type IN ('GAS', 'NONE', 'DIESEL') AND Revocation_Indicator = 'N'

dmv.1100.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DMV  WHERE Record_Type = 'VEH' AND Registration_Class IN ('COM', 'LTR') AND County IN ('HERKIMER', 'GENESEE', 'OTSEGO', 'FULTON', 'GREENE', 'FRANKLIN', 'MONTGOMERY', 'CHENANGO', 'TIOGA', 'DELAWARE', 'WYOMING', 'ALLEGANY', 'CORTLAND', 'ESSEX', 'ORLEANS', 'SENECA', 'SCHOHARIE', 'LEWIS', 'YATES', 'SCHUYLER', 'HAMILTON') AND Body_Type IN ('BOAT', 'LTRL', 'MCY', 'TRLR') AND Suspension_Indicator = 'N'

dmv.179.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DMV  WHERE Record_Type = 'VEH' AND Registration_Class IN ('BOT', 'MOT') AND State IN ('NY', 'NJ', 'OK', 'PA', 'MD', 'IL', 'TX', 'FL', 'GA', 'CT', 'IN', 'OH', 'WI', 'MA', 'AZ', 'CA') AND Body_Type IN ('4DSD', 'PICK') AND Suspension_Indicator = 'N' AND Revocation_Indicator = 'N'
